title: On certain $D(9)$ and $D(64)$ Diophantine triples
summary: A set of $m$ distinct positive integers $\{a_{1},\dots a_{m}\}$ is called a $D(q)$-$m$-tuple for nonzero integer $q$ if the product of any two increased by $q$, $a_{i}a_{j}+q$, $i\neq j$ is a perfect square. Due to certain properties of the sequence, there are many $D(q)$-Diophantine triples related to the Fibonacci numbers. A result of Baćić and Filipin characterizes the solutions of Pellian equations that correspond to $D(4)$-Diophantine triples of a certain form.
